title: Whispers of the Masterforger
story: In the dimly lit corners of the prestigious Art Gallery, an unsavory secret has been unfolding for years. The once-treasured art pieces now bear suspicious resemblance to other renowned pieces, leading to the unsettling truth: these are counterfeit masterpieces. Our unsuspecting victim, esteemed curator Dr. Amelia Blake, discovered the art fraud upon a routine inspection. The crime scene is the opulent Museum Gallery, where the enigmatic paintings of renowned artists have been inexplicably replaced with bogus copies.
crimeScene: The Museum Gallery - a room dedicated to celebrated artists and their authentic masterpieces
forensicClue: The distinct odor of acidic varnish emanates from the counterfeit artworks.
question: Who is the imposter behind this art forgery scheme? How did the detective solve the mystery?
options: A. Mr. Charles Whitmore (Curator of Fakes), reason: His expertise in creating convincing counterfeits.
B. Ms. Isabella Montez (Collector), reason: Her motive for replacements to boost her collection's value.
C. Monsieur Andreas Raffael (Restorer), reason: His access to the Museum Gallery and familiarity with the original varnish scent.
D. Professor Edwardo Santos (Art Historian), reason: The unusual varnish odor only he would notice.
E. Mr. Benjamin Franklin (Security Guard), reason: His connection to the forgeries' origin.
